spans.text: **保留所有信息**：title / subtitle / bullets（每条 head + detail）/ narrative / data_points / inherited_table 的所有行和列 / inherited_image 的存在及其语义 —— 全部必须落到 query 里，不得省略、不得改写数字 / 专有名词 / 百分比。
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes preserving information integrity. It explicitly requires that all data, numbers, proper nouns, and percentages be preserved exactly without alteration. It mandates that all information from the input be faithfully represented in the output, which supports truthfulness and information provenance.
